mcq.x: Protection of wild animals and birds (Entry 17B, added 1976) and price control (Entry 34) are in the Concurrent List; taxes on agricultural income (Entry 46) and on electricity (Entry 53) are State List subjects.

Directive Principles of State Policy have been provided

mcq.s: Which of the following are unitary elements in the Indian federal system? (i) Decentralisation of powers (ii) Appointment of Governors (iii) Unequal representation of States in the Rajya Sabha (iv) Judicial review (v) All India Services (vi) Bicameral legislature
mcq.x: Governors appointed by the Centre, unequal (population-based) representation in the Rajya Sabha and the All India Services are unitary features; division of powers, judicial review and bicameralism are federal features.

mcq.s: Identify the incorrect statement regarding the judicial interpretation of Article 21 after the Supreme Court's verdict in the Maneka Gandhi case, 1978.
o: The burden lies on the petitioner to prove that the procedure established by law is fair, just and reasonable
'Procedure established by law' is by and large synonymous with procedural due process
Articles 14, 19 and 21 are not mutually exclusive
The 'Right to Life' includes the 'Right to live with dignity'
mcq.x: Maneka Gandhi held that the procedure under Article 21 must be fair, just and reasonable (close to due process), read Articles 14, 19 and 21 together and widened life to a life with dignity; it put no such burden on the petitioner.

mcq.s: Match List-I (Subject) with List-II (Article): A. To foster respect for international law B. To have compassion for living creatures C. To develop the spirit of inquiry and reform D. To separate the judiciary from the executive — 1. Article 51(c) 2. Article 51A(g) 3. Article 51A(h) 4. Article 50
